description: This file defines the interface for IAVBufferHelper, an abstract class providing methods to handle memory mapping, unmapping, size querying, and secure data operations related to buffer handles. It includes a nested struct CopyMap used for copying memory segments, and declares a factory function to instantiate the helper.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An interface class that declares methods for mapping/unmapping memory, retrieving allocation size, and secure handle operations related to buffer management.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a handle; returns pointer to memory and size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with a handle.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of memory allocated for a handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer identified by handle.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure buffers based on a provided mapping.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
